children: Alessia Berardi, head of global macroeconomics and emerging markets strategy at the Amundi Investment Institute, discussed the outlook for global bonds after the Federal Reserve and Bank of Japan raised interest rates, according to Bloomberg.
She also cited elevated energy prices and fiscal risks during an appearance on Bloomberg TV’s "The Pulse with Francine Lacqua."

title: Amundi’s Berardi Sees Fragility Persisting in Global Markets
